```{r}
#### Use this function to load all available datasets and return an R environment containing all data objects.
load_IMPACC_datasets <- function(DATA_VERSION, 
                                 KEEP_COVID19_POS, 
                                 #PHASES = 1:100, 
                                 ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS = 
                                   c("IMPACC sample assayed and passed QC", 
                                     "IMPACC sample assayed with questionable QC"),
                                 FILTER_BY_CORE_ASSAY_COHORT = TRUE,
                                 EVENT_DATE_UPPER = 365,
                                 VISIT_UPPER = 10
                                 ) {
  
  #### Load packages necessary for data loading and processing purpose
  load_packages(c(packages, packages_imputation))
  
  #### Define Data directories: Use the absolute path of the directory containing "current" and "legacy" directories.
  data_dirs <- c(
      bld_cytof_dir = "/data/bld-cytof",
      bld_gwas_dir = "/data/bld-gwas",
      clinical_dir = "/data/clinical",
      ea_cytof_dir = "/data/ea-cytof",
      ea_metagenomics_dir = "/data/ea-metagenomics",
      ea_transcriptomics_dir = "/data/ea-transcriptomics",
      plasma_metabolomics_global_dir = "/data/metabolomics/plasma-metabolomics-global",
      plasma_metabolomics_targeted_dir = "/data/metabolomics/plasma-metabolomics-targeted",
      serum_metabolomics_global_dir = "/data/metabolomics/serum-metabolomics-global",
      nasal_metagenomics_dir = "/data/nasal-metagenomics",
      nasal_transcriptomics_dir = "/data/nasal-transcriptomics",
      nasal_viralload_dir = "/data/nasal-viralload",
      nasal_viralseq_dir = "/data/nasal-viralseq",
      pbmc_transcriptomics_dir = "/data/pbmc-transcriptomics",
      plasma_proteomics_targeted_dir = "/data/proteomics/plasma-proteomics-targeted",
      plasma_proteomics_global_dda_dir = "/data/proteomics/plasma-proteomics-global-DDA",
      plasma_proteomics_global_dia_dir = "/data/proteomics/plasma-proteomics-global-DIA",
      serum_proteomics_global_dir = "/data/proteomics/serum-proteomics-global",
      serum_olink_dir = "/data/serum-olink",
      serum_rbd_abtiters_dir = "/data/serum-rbd-abtiters",
      serum_sarscov2_abtiters_dir = "/data/serum-sarscov2-abtiters"
  )
  
  #### Create an empty environment for storing various data objects
  data_env <- env(data_dirs = data_dirs)
  
  #### Prepare clinical data variables
  data_env <- prepare_clinical_data(data_env, DATA_VERSION, KEEP_COVID19_POS, FILTER_BY_CORE_ASSAY_COHORT, EVENT_DATE_UPPER, VISIT_UPPER)#, PHASES

  #### Prepare info for the assay data files
  data_env <- prepare_assay_files_info(data_env)
  
  #### Fetch appropriate data files and load assay datasets
  data_env <- load_assay_data(data_env, DATA_VERSION, ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS)

  #### Prepare predefined color schemes
  data_env <- prepare_color_schemes(data_env)
  
  #### Store DATA_VERSION and PHASES info in data_env
  data_env[[ "DATA_VERSION" ]] <- DATA_VERSION
  #data_env[[ "PHASES" ]] <- PHASES
  data_env[[ "ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS" ]] <- ALLOWED_SMPL_STATUS
  
  return(data_env)
     
}
```

```{r panel-b-analysis, warning=FALSE}
# subset the data to only get 'Visit 1'
data_use_visit1 <- wgcnaRes$MEs %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample_id") %>%
  merge(y  = dplyr::select(clinical_data, 
                    sample_id, 
                    event_type,
                    conv_cluster4,
                    enrollment_site,
                    discretized_admit_age_quantile,
                    bmi,
                    sex),
        by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(event_type %in% "Visit 1" &
         !is.na(conv_cluster4)) %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = factor(conv_cluster4)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-event_type) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample_id")

# a model with only intercept and random effect across sites
module_names <- grep(pattern = "met", names(data_use_visit1), value = TRUE)
res_table_ordinal <- NULL
data_use <- data_use_visit1
for (moduleName in module_names) {
  my.formula0 <- paste0('conv_cluster4~ 1+(1|enrollment_site)+',
                        'discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex+bmi') 
  my.formula1 <- paste0('conv_cluster4~',
                        moduleName,
                        '+(1|enrollment_site)+',
                        'discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex+bmi') 
  res <- mixed_ordinal(my.formula0, 
                       my.formula1,
                       data_use = data_use_visit1)
  coef(clmm(formula(my.formula1), 
            data = data_use_visit1))[moduleName] %>%
    unname() %>%
    c(res, coef = .) -> res
  res_table_ordinal <- rbind(res_table_ordinal, res)
}
rownames(res_table_ordinal) <- module_names
res_table_ordinal <- res_table_ordinal %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
   mutate(qval =  qvalue::qvalue(pval, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues)

```

### Functions: model_loop
```{r}
model_loop <- function(inputDF, modelType = "lme", age_sex =TRUE, knots = c(1, 4, 7, 14, 21),
                       endpoint = "conv_cluster4", old_p_corrections = FALSE){
  inputDF$participant_id = as.factor(inputDF$participant_id )
  if(modelType == "smoothSpline"){
    inputDF$event_date_transformed = inputDF$event_date
    lmDF <- mgcv_global(inputDF, endpoint, age_sex = age_sex)
    lmDF$name <- rownames(lmDF)
    ## Because of the pairwise function requires there to be a column for "name"
    ## the rownames are copied to a new column here, ultimately this column is removed
  } else {
    lmDF <- inputDF %>%
      group_by(name) %>% 
      do(p.slope = {
        if(modelType == "lme"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                            "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint)), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
        } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                             "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint)), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
        }
        if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
            idx <- nrow(anova(fit))
            result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[idx]
        } else {
          result = NA
        }
      }, 
      p.intercept = {
        if(modelType == "lme"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint)), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
        } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint)), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
          
        }
        if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
          result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[3] #conv_cluster is position 3
        }else{
          result = NA
        }
      },
      p.intercept.sex = {
        if(age_sex){
          if(modelType == "lme"){
              fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                                                       "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), data = .,
                             random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
              fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                                                       "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), 
                             data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
          if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
            result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[4] ## sex is position 4
          } else {
            result = NA
          }
        }
      },
      p.intercept.age.quantile = {
        if(age_sex){
          if(modelType == "lme"){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile+event_location")), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
          if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
            result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[5] ## discretized_admit_age_quantile is position 4
          } else {
            result = NA
          }
        }
      }
      ) %>% ungroup() %>%
      mutate(p.slope = unlist(p.slope),
             p.intercept  = unlist(p.intercept),
             p.intercept.sex  = unlist(p.intercept.sex),
             p.intercept.age.quantile  = unlist(p.intercept.age.quantile),
      ) %>% as.data.frame()
    lmDF$adjp.intercept=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.intercept, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    lmDF$adjp.slope=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.slope, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    lmDF$adjp.intercept.sex=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.intercept.sex, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    lmDF$adjp.intercept.age.quantile=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.intercept.age.quantile, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
  }
  
  message("\n Initial calculation of p.slope and p.intercept complete. Beginning pairwise comparisons.")
  #### Pairwise comparisons #### 
  ## Loop the pairwise comparisons ##
  for(i in seq_along(rownames(lmDF))){ 
    if(age_sex){
      tmp.out = matrix(NA,ncol = ncol(combn(unique(inputDF[[endpoint]]), 2)), nrow =4)
    }else{tmp.out = matrix(NA,ncol = ncol(combn(unique(inputDF[[endpoint]]), 2)), nrow =2)}
    
    try(
      if(modelType == "lme"){
        tmp.out <- pairwise_lme_modeling(inputDF[inputDF$name == lmDF$name[i],],
                                         variable = endpoint, fixedKnots = F)
      } else if(modelType == "fixedKnots"){
        tmp.out <- pairwise_lme_modeling(inputDF[inputDF$name == lmDF$name[i],],
                                         variable = endpoint, fixedKnots = T, knots = knots)
      } else if (modelType == "smoothSpline"){
        tmp.out <- pairwise_mgcv_modeling(inputDF[inputDF$name == lmDF$name[i],],
                                          variable = endpoint)
      })
    if(age_sex){
      if(i==1){
        values.out <- c(tmp.out[1,], tmp.out[2,], tmp.out[3,], tmp.out[4,])
        names(values.out) <- c(paste0(rownames(tmp.out)[1],"_", colnames(tmp.out[,1:ncol(tmp.out), drop=FALSE])),
                               paste0(rownames(tmp.out)[2],"_", colnames(tmp.out[,1:ncol(tmp.out), drop=FALSE])),
                               paste0(rownames(tmp.out)[3],"_", colnames(tmp.out[,1:ncol(tmp.out), drop=FALSE])),
                               paste0(rownames(tmp.out)[4],"_", colnames(tmp.out[,1:ncol(tmp.out), drop=FALSE])))
      } else {
        values.out <- rbind(values.out, c(tmp.out[1,], tmp.out[2,], tmp.out[3,], tmp.out[4,]))
      }
    }else{
      if(i==1){
        values.out <- c(tmp.out[1,], tmp.out[2,])
        names(values.out) <- c(paste0(rownames(tmp.out)[1],"_", colnames(tmp.out[,1:ncol(tmp.out), drop=FALSE])),
                               paste0(rownames(tmp.out)[2],"_", colnames(tmp.out[,1:ncol(tmp.out), drop=FALSE])))
      } else {
        values.out <- rbind(values.out, c(tmp.out[1,], tmp.out[2,]))
      }
    }
    
  }
  ## Change to use qvalue like in tidyr loop
  if(old_p_corrections){
    p.slope.adj <- apply(values.out[,grepl("p.slope", colnames(values.out)), drop=FALSE], 2, function(x){
      qvalue::qvalue(x, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    })
    
    p.intercept.adj <- apply(values.out[,grepl("p.intercept", colnames(values.out)), drop=FALSE], 2, function(x){
      qvalue::qvalue(x, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    })
  } else {
    p.slope.adj <- as.data.frame(values.out[,grepl("p.slope", colnames(values.out)), drop=FALSE])
    #p.slope.adj <- qvalue::qvalue(as.vector(p.slope.adj), fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    vector <- as.vector(p.slope.adj)
    vector <- as.data.frame(vector)
    p.slope.adj <- qvalue::qvalue(vector, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    p.intercept.adj <- as.data.frame(values.out[,grepl("p.intercept", colnames(values.out)), drop=FALSE])
  #  p.intercept.adj <- qvalue::qvalue(as.vector(p.intercept.adj), fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    vector2 <- as.vector(p.intercept.adj)
    vector2 <- as.data.frame(vector2)
    p.intercept.adj <- qvalue::qvalue(vector2, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
  }
  colnames(p.slope.adj) <- gsub("_", ".adj_", colnames(p.slope.adj))
  colnames(p.intercept.adj) <- gsub("_", ".adj_", colnames(p.intercept.adj))
  
  lmDF_pairwise <- as.data.frame(cbind(lmDF, values.out, p.slope.adj, p.intercept.adj))
  rownames(lmDF_pairwise) <- lmDF_pairwise$name
  lmDF_pairwise <- lmDF_pairwise[,colnames(lmDF_pairwise) != "name"]
  return(lmDF_pairwise)
}
generate_WGCNA_modules <-
  function(data_df,
           networkType = "signed",
           power = NULL,
           minModuleSize = NULL,
           reassignThreshold = 1e-6,
           mergeCutHeight = 0.15,
           minKMEtoStay = 0.3,
           minCoreKME = 0.5,
           corType = "bicor",
           maxPOutliers = 0.1,
           assay_alias = NULL,   ### Append this assay_alias to the module names as prefix.
           includ_grey_in_plots = TRUE,
           plot_heatmap = TRUE,
           ...) {
    
    #### Load packages necessary for data loading and processing purpose
    load_packages(c(packages, packages_WGCNA))

    if( is.null( c(power, minModuleSize) ) ) {
      cat("ERROR:: Provide values for both power and minModuleSize parameters\n")
      return()
    }
    
    ## Network construction 
    net = blockwiseModules(
    data_df,
    power = power,
    networkType = networkType,
    TOMType = "unsigned",
    minModuleSize = minModuleSize,
    reassignThreshold = reassignThreshold,
    mergeCutHeight = mergeCutHeight,
    numericLabels = TRUE,
    pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
    minKMEtoStay = minKMEtoStay,
    minCoreKME = minCoreKME,
    corType = corType,
    verbose = 3,
    maxPOutliers = maxPOutliers,
    ...
  )
  
  # Convert labels to colors for plotting
  mergedColors = labels2colors(net$colors)
  module_labels = paste0("mod",net$colors) %>% setNames(names(net$colors))
  module_color_key = labels2colors(unique(net$colors)) %>% setNames(paste0("mod",unique(net$colors)))
  # Plot the dendrogram and the module colors underneath
  plotDendroAndColors(
    net$dendrograms[[1]],
    mergedColors[net$blockGenes[[1]]],
    "Module colors",
    dendroLabels = FALSE,
    hang = 0.03,
    addGuide = TRUE,
    guideHang = 0.05
  )
  
  if( ! is.null(assay_alias) ) {
    module_labels = paste0(assay_alias, "_", module_labels)
    module_color_key = labels2colors(unique(net$colors)) %>% setNames(paste0(assay_alias, "_","mod",unique(net$colors)))
  }
  
  # Recalculate MEs with module labels
  MEs = moduleEigengenes(data_df, module_labels)$eigengenes
  colnames(MEs) = gsub("^ME","",colnames(MEs))
  #MEs = orderMEs(MEs)
  
  module_membership = data.frame( feature = colnames(data_df), module = module_labels )
  
  if(plot_heatmap) {
    conv_cluster = clinical_data %>% dplyr::slice( match( row.names(data_df), clinical_data$sample_id ) ) %>% pull(conv_cluster)
    
    non_grey_data = data_df[,! grepl("mod0", module_membership$module)]
    data_for_plot = non_grey_data
    module_for_plot = module_membership$module[ ! grepl("mod0", module_membership$module) ]
    if(includ_grey_in_plots) {
      data_for_plot = data_df
      module_for_plot = module_membership$module
    }
    data_for_plot = apply(data_for_plot, 2, scale) %>% `rownames<-`(rownames(data_for_plot))
    p <-
      Heatmap(
      data_for_plot, 
      column_title_rot = 90,
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=10),
      column_split = module_for_plot,
      show_column_names = FALSE,
      show_row_names = FALSE,
      left_annotation = rowAnnotation( CC = conv_cluster, col=list(CC = brewer.greens(5) %>% setNames(1:5) ) ),
      top_annotation = columnAnnotation( modules = module_for_plot, col=list(modules = module_color_key ) )
      )
    draw(p, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 15, 5), "mm"))
    #print(p)

  p2 <- 
    Heatmap(
      t(data_for_plot),
      column_title_rot = 90,
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize=10),
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize=6),
      column_split = conv_cluster,
      show_column_names = FALSE,
      top_annotation = columnAnnotation( CC = conv_cluster, col=list(CC = brewer.greens(5) %>% setNames(1:5) ) ),
      left_annotation = rowAnnotation( modules = module_for_plot, col=list(modules = module_color_key ) )
    )
  
  draw(p2, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 15, 5), "mm"))
  #print(p)
  }
  
  colnames(MEs) = gsub("^ME", "", colnames(MEs))
  
  print("Note: mod0 = 'grey' module")
  
  return( 
          list( 
            module_membership = module_membership, 
            MEs = MEs,  
            p1 = p
            ) 
          )
}
PVCA <- function(counts, meta, threshold, inter){
#counts = tmet
#            meta = pdata
#            inter = FALSE
#            threshold = 0.6
  counts.center <- t(apply(counts, 1, scale, center=TRUE, scale=FALSE))
  cor.counts <- cor(counts.center)
  dim(cor.counts)
  eigen.counts <- eigen(cor.counts)
  eigen.mat <- eigen.counts$vectors
  eigen.val <- eigen.counts$values
  n.eigen <- length(eigen.val)
  eigen.val.sum <- sum(eigen.val)
  percents.pcs <- eigen.val/eigen.val.sum
  meta <- as.data.frame(meta)

  all <- 0
  npc.in <- 0
  for(i in 1:n.eigen){
    all <- all + percents.pcs[i]
    npc.in <- npc.in + 1
    if(all > threshold){break}
  }
  if (npc.in < 3) {npc <- 3}

  pred.list <- colnames(meta)
  meta <- droplevels(meta)

  n.preds <- ncol(meta) + 1
  if(inter) {n.preds <- n.preds + choose(ncol(meta),2)}

  ran.pred.list <- c()
  for(i in 1:ncol(meta)){
    ran.pred.list <- c(ran.pred.list, paste0("(1|", pred.list[i],")"))
  }
  ##interactions
  if(inter){
    for(i in 1:(ncol(meta)-1)){
      for(j in (i+1):ncol(meta)){
        ran.pred.list <- c(ran.pred.list, paste0("(1|", pred.list[i], ":", pred.list[j], ")"))
        pred.list <- c(pred.list, paste0(pred.list[i], ":", pred.list[j]))
      }
    }
  }
  formula <- paste(ran.pred.list, collapse = " + ")
  formula <- paste("pc", formula, sep=" ~ ")
  ran.var.mat <- NULL
  for(i in 1:npc.in){
    dat <- cbind(eigen.mat[,i],meta)
    colnames(dat) <- c("pc",colnames(meta))
    Rm1ML <- lme4::lmer(formula, dat, REML = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, na.action = na.omit)
    var.vec <- unlist(VarCorr(Rm1ML))
    ran.var.mat <- rbind(ran.var.mat, c(var.vec[pred.list], resid = sigma(Rm1ML)^2))
  }
  ran.var.mat.std <- ran.var.mat/rowSums(ran.var.mat)
  wgt.vec <- eigen.val/eigen.val.sum
  prop.var <- colSums(ran.var.mat.std*wgt.vec[1:npc.in])
  std.prop.var <- prop.var/sum(prop.var)
  std.prop.var
}
```

```{r add-longidinal-pairwise}
# use linear regression to infer direction

#install.packages("varhandle") #to use unfactor function

inputDF$conv_cluster4 = unfactor(inputDF$conv_cluster4)
combMat <- combn(unique(inputDF$conv_cluster4), m = 2)
coefCombMat <- apply(combMat, MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(comparison) {
  print(comparison)
  inputTemp <- filter(inputDF, conv_cluster4 %in% comparison) %>%
  print(table(inputTemp$conv_cluster4))
  coefDF <- lapply(rownames(smooth_spline_model_loop), FUN = function(modName) {
    #print(modName)
    fit <- lme(fixed  = value ~ event_date *conv_cluster4 + sex + discretized_admit_age_quantile + event_location,
               random = ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id,
               data   = filter(inputTemp, name %in% modName))
    average <- unique(coef(fit)[grep(pattern = "^conv_cluster4",
                                     colnames(coef(fit)))]) %>%
      unlist() %>%
      unname()
    shape <- unique(coef(fit)[grep(pattern = "^event_date:conv_cluster4",
                                     colnames(coef(fit)))]) %>%
      unlist() %>%
      unname()
    return(value = data.frame(`Module (or Feature)` = modName,
                              average, 
                              shape,
                              comparison = paste(sort(comparison), collapse = "|"),
                              check.names = FALSE))
  }) %>%
    do.call(what = rbind)
  return(value = coefDF)
}) %>%
  do.call(what = rbind)
```

```{r}
exampleDF <- data_use %>%
  filter(name %in% "globalmet_mod3") %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = ordered(as.factor(as.character(conv_cluster4)), 
                                    levels = c("1", "2", "5", "6")))

#longitudinal_plot <- function(exampleDF, endpoint = "conv_cluster4", model_formula,
                      #        colors, title, xlabel, ylabel, font,
                       #       group_trendline = T, group_trendline_color = "blue", group_trendline_line_width = 1.5,
                       #       individual_points = T, individual_points_size = 1, individual_points_alpha = 0.8,
                       #       individual_paths = T, individual_paths_size = 1, individual_paths_alpha = 0.4){
endpoint = "conv_cluster4"
  formula_lmer <- formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint, " + sex + discretized_admit_age_quantile + (1|enrollment_site/participant_id)"))
 # my_colors = c("#639A21", "#39828C", "#9C3418", "#0072B2")
    
  exampleDFmod <- exampleDF
  exampleDFmod$sex <- "Female"
  exampleDFmod$discretized_admit_age_quantile <- unique(exampleDFmod$discretized_admit_age_quantile)[1]
  fit <- lmer(formula_lmer, data = exampleDF)
  exampleDF$yhat <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = exampleDF)
  exampleDF$yhat_wo_re <- stats::predict(fit, re.form=NA, newdata=exampleDFmod)
  ################ Plotting ################ 
  p1 <- ggplot(data = exampleDF, mapping = aes(x = event_date, y = value)) + 
    geom_line(mapping = aes(group = participant_id, y = value), color ='gray', alpha = 0.08) + 
    geom_point(mapping = aes_string(color = endpoint), alpha = 0.08,
                          size = 1) + 
    geom_line(mapping = aes_string(group = endpoint, y = "yhat_wo_re"),
                         color = 'black', size = 1.5) +
    #geom_line(aes(colour = my_colors)) +
    theme_bw() + 
    #labs(y = unique(exampleDF$name)) + 
    theme(legend.pos = "none") + 
    ggtitle(paste0(unique(exampleDF$name), " by ", endpoint)) +
    facet_wrap(facets = ~conv_cluster4, nrow = 1) +
    #facet_grid(facets = get(facet_rows)~get(endpoint)) + 
    #theme(text=element_text(family=font)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#639A21", "#39828C", "#9C3418", "#0072B2"))+
    xlab("Days from Admission") + ylab("Eigenvalue")
#}
```

#mod18 - linear model plot
```{r}
#longitudinal_plot <- function(exampleDF, endpoint = "conv_cluster4", model_formula,
                       #       colors, title, xlabel, ylabel, font,
                        #      group_trendline = T, group_trendline_color = "blue", group_trendline_line_width = 1.5,
                        #      individual_points = T, individual_points_size = 1, individual_points_alpha = 0.8,
                          #    individual_paths = T, individual_paths_size = 1, individual_paths_alpha = 0.4){
exampleDF <- data_use %>%
  filter(name %in% "globalmet_mod18") %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = ordered(as.factor(as.character(conv_cluster4)), 
                                    levels = c("1", "2", "5", "6")))

endpoint = "conv_cluster4"
  formula_lmer <- formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint, " + sex + discretized_admit_age_quantile + (1|enrollment_site/participant_id)"))
    
  exampleDFmod <- exampleDF
  exampleDFmod$sex <- "Female"
  exampleDFmod$discretized_admit_age_quantile <- unique(exampleDFmod$discretized_admit_age_quantile)[1]
  fit <- lmer(formula_lmer, data = exampleDF)
  exampleDF$yhat <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = exampleDF)
  exampleDF$yhat_wo_re <- stats::predict(fit, re.form=NA, newdata=exampleDFmod)
  ################ Plotting ################ 
  p1 <- ggplot(data = exampleDF, mapping = aes(x = event_date, y = value)) + 
    geom_line(mapping = aes(group = participant_id, y = value), color ='gray', alpha = 0.08) + 
    geom_point(mapping = aes_string(color = endpoint), alpha = 0.08,
                          size = 1) + 
    geom_line(mapping = aes_string(group = endpoint, y = "yhat_wo_re"),
                         color = 'black', size = 1.5) +
    theme_bw() + 
    #labs(y = unique(exampleDF$name)) + 
    theme(legend.pos = "none") + 
    ggtitle(paste0(unique(exampleDF$name), " by ", endpoint)) +
    facet_wrap(facets = ~conv_cluster4, nrow = 1) +
    #facet_grid(facets = get(facet_rows)~get(endpoint)) + 
    #theme(text=element_text(family=font)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#639A21", "#39828C", "#9C3418", "#0072B2"))+
    xlab("Days from Admission") + ylab("Eigenvalue")
#}
```

```{r}
exampleDF <- data_use %>%
  filter(name %in% "globalmet_mod22") %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = ordered(as.factor(as.character(conv_cluster4)), 
                                    levels = c("1", "2", "5", "6")))

plotExample <- plot_model(exampleDF, 
                          model_loop     = smooth_spline_model_loop, 
                          modelType      = "smoothSpline", 
                          p_adjust       = NA, 
                          endpoint       = "conv_cluster4", 
                          signif_markers = FALSE,
                          remove_NS      = TRUE, 
                          bar_height     = 6.5)

plotMod22 <- plotExample$data %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = paste0("CC", conv_cluster4)) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = event_date, y = value)) +
  #ggtitle("mod26 - Chemical") +
    geom_line(mapping = aes(group = participant_id, y = value), 
              color   = 'gray',
              alpha   = 0.4) +
    geom_line(mapping = aes(group = participant_id, y = yhat), 
              size    = 0.6, 
              alpha   = 0.5,
              color   = "black") +
    geom_point(mapping = aes(color = conv_cluster4)) +
    geom_line(data    = mutate(get("pred", plotExample$plot_env),
                               conv_cluster4 = paste0("CC", 
                                                         conv_cluster4)),
              mapping = aes(group = conv_cluster4, y = predicted),
                           color = "black", size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(facets = ~conv_cluster4, nrow = 1) +
    labs(y = "Eigenvalue",  x = "Days from admission") + #,  tag = "C"
    scale_color_manual(values= c("CC1"  = "#639A21",
                                 "CC2"  = "#39828C",
                                 "CC5"  = "#9C3418",
                                 "CC6"  = "#0072B2")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 42)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.pos = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + theme(axis.title=element_text(size=15), legend.title= element_text (size=15))+theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 13)) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15))


print(plotMod22) #5.46 * 15.28
#pdf(file.path(out_dir, "main_C.pdf"), width=8, height = 8) #5.5*9
#print(plotMod3)
#dev.off()
```

### Features of each significant longitudinal module
```{r panel-d-output-gen, warning=FALSE}
metInfo1_temp <- metInfo1
#metInfo1_temp$moduleColor[metInfo1_temp$moduleColor == "globalmet_mod4"] <- "Xenobiotics"
globalmet_mod4 <- metInfo1_temp$moduleColor[metInfo1_temp$moduleColor == "globalmet_mod4"] 
#panelD <- ggplot(data=subset(metInfo1, moduleColor=="globalmet_mod8"), aes(x=reorder(SUB_PATHWAY, SUB_PATHWAY))) +xlab ("SUB_PATHWAY")+scale_fill_grey(start=0.1, end=0.5)+
  panelD <- ggplot(data=subset(metInfo1_temp, moduleColor=="globalmet_mod4"), aes(x=reorder(SUB_PATHWAY, SUB_PATHWAY))) +xlab ("SUB_PATHWAY")+
    #scale_fill_grey(start=0.1, end=0.5)+
   # geom_bar(stat="count", position = "stack")
geom_bar(aes(fill = SUPER_PATHWAY), position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) + theme_bw()+ #+ geom_text(stat='count', size=4, aes(label=..count..), vjust=-0.1)+  
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust=0.8, hjust=1),
        axis.text.y=element_text (size=10)) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values= c("Amino Acid"  = "#639A21",
                                 "Lipid"  = "#39828C",
                                 "Xenobiotics"  = "#9C3418",
                                 "Partially Characterized Molecules"  = "#0072B2")) +
theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.text = element_text(size=10))+ facet_wrap (~moduleColor, ncol=8) +guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=2,byrow=TRUE)) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 15))+ theme(axis.title=element_text(size=10))

 
print(panelD)
```

```{r}
# Subset the data to only get 'Visit 1':
clinical_subsets = clinical_data #run to determine which modules to plot
rownames(clinical_subsets) = clinical_subsets$sample_id
row_ids = rownames(plasma_metabolomics_global_counts)
clinical_subsets = clinical_subsets[row_ids,]
visit1_row_ids = rownames(clinical_subsets[clinical_subsets$event_type == 'Visit 1',])

# Use the visit1_row_ids to only get samples from 'Visit 1':
modules_filtered = wgcnaRes$MEs[visit1_row_ids ,]
clinical_subsets = clinical_subsets[visit1_row_ids ,]
data_use = modules_filtered 

# Add the respiratory_status_day14 as $endpoints
data_use$endpoints = as.factor(clinical_subsets$conv_cluster4) #Make sure that you change this depend of endpoint

# Add the enrollment_site as $sites
data_use$sites = clinical_subsets$enrollment_site
data_use$age =  clinical_subsets$discretized_admit_age_quantile
data_use$sex =  clinical_subsets$sex

#Add other clinical information based on pvca
data_use$bmi = clinical_subsets$bmi
data_use$event_location = clinical_subsets$event_location
# Add the $control, needs to be different for each sample
# required for clmm (always requires some random effect)
data_use$control =  factor(1:nrow(data_use))

# Set module names:
module_names = colnames(modules_filtered)

# Only use samples that have valid endpoints (not NA/missing)
data_use = data_use[!is.na(data_use$endpoints),]
```

#Significant visit 1 analysis module identification
```{r}
res_table_ordinal <- data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = 4, nrow = length(module_names)))
colnames(res_table_ordinal) <- c("AIC", "pval", "qval", "coef")
rownames(res_table_ordinal) <- module_names
for(j in 1:length(module_names)) {
  my.formula0 <- paste0('endpoints~ 1+(1|sites)+age+sex+bmi')
  my.formula1 <- paste0('endpoints~',module_names[j],'+(1|sites)+age+sex+bmi')
  res_table_ordinal[j,1:2] <- mixed_ordinal(my.formula0, my.formula1,data_use)
  res_table_ordinal[j,4] <- ordinal::clmm(formula(my.formula1), 
                                          data = data_use) %>%
    coef() %>%
    .[module_names[j]]
}
res_table_ordinal$qval <- qvalue::qvalue(res_table_ordinal$pval, 
                                         fdr.level = 0.05, 
                                         pi0       = 1)$qvalues

head(res_table_ordinal) %>%
  kable()
```


```{r wgcna-pairwise-visit1, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# subfunction use to fit ordinal regression and extract reg. coef

mixed_pairwise_coef <- function(my.formula0, my.formula1, data_use) {
  endpoints0 <- sort(unique(data_use$endpoints))
  pair_names <- c()
  res_table <- c()
  for(i in 1:(length(endpoints0)-1)){
    for(j in (i+1):(length(endpoints0))){
      pair_names <- c(pair_names, paste0(endpoints0[i],"|", endpoints0[j]))
      data_tmp <- data_use[data_use$endpoints %in% endpoints0[c(i, j)], ]
      fit <- lme4::lmer(my.formula1, data = data_tmp)
      res_table <- c(res_table, 
                     unique(coef(fit)$sites[,grep(pattern = "endpoint", 
                                               names(coef(fit)$sites))]))
    }
  }
  names(res_table) <- pair_names
  return(value = res_table)
}
  
res_table_pairwise <- NULL
res_table_pairwise_coef <- NULL
for(j in 1:length(module_names)){
  my.formula0 = paste0(module_names[j],"~ (1|sites)+age+sex+bmi")
  my.formula1 = paste0(module_names[j],"~ endpoints + (1|sites)+age+sex+bmi")
  res_table_pairwise <- rbind(res_table_pairwise,
                              mixed_pairwise(my.formula0, my.formula1, data_use))
  res_table_pairwise_coef <- rbind(res_table_pairwise_coef,
                                   mixed_pairwise_coef(my.formula0, 
                                                       my.formula1, 
                                                       data_use))
}
rownames(res_table_pairwise) <- module_names
rownames(res_table_pairwise_coef) <- module_names
```

#Longitudinal DFSO analysis
```{r}
clinical_subsets = clinical_data
rownames(clinical_subsets) = clinical_subsets$sample_id
row_ids = rownames(plasma_metabolomics_global_counts)
clinical_subsets = clinical_subsets[row_ids,]
modules_scores = wgcnaRes$MEs

modules_filtered =modules_scores
clinical_subsets = clinical_subsets

data_use <- cbind(modules_filtered, 
                  clinical_subsets[, c("conv_cluster4", "event_date", "enrollment_site",          "participant_id","discretized_admit_age_quantile", "sex", "symptom_date")])

inputDF <- data_use%>%
  mutate(event_date = event_date - symptom_date) %>%
  dplyr::select(-symptom_date) %>%
  filter(!is.na(event_date)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(duplicated(participant_id) | duplicated(participant_id, fromLast = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("sample_id", "event_date", "participant_id",
                         "enrollment_site", "conv_cluster4",
                         "discretized_admit_age_quantile", "sex")) %>%
  mutate(discretized_admit_age_quantile= factor(discretized_admit_age_quantile)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value) & !is.na(conv_cluster4))

inputDF$conv_cluster4 <- as.factor(inputDF$conv_cluster4)
inputDF$sex <- as.factor(inputDF$sex)
inputDF$participant_id <- as.factor(inputDF$participant_id)
inputDF$enrollment_site <- as.factor(inputDF$enrollment_site)
```

```{r smooth-spline-regression-dfso, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
smooth_spline_model_loop <- model_loop(inputDF, modelType = "smoothSpline", endpoint = "conv_cluster4")

# fetch directionality from lme
smooth_spline_model_loop$conv_cluster4 <- NA
smooth_spline_model_loop$"event_date:conv_cluster4" <- NA
for (modName in rownames(smooth_spline_model_loop)) {
  fit <- lme(fixed= value ~ event_date * conv_cluster4 + sex + discretized_admit_age_quantile,
      random = ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id,
      data = filter(inputDF, name %in% modName))
smooth_spline_model_loop[modName, "conv_cluster4"] <- unique(coef(fit)["conv_cluster4",])
smooth_spline_model_loop[modName, "event_date:conv_cluster4"] <- unique(coef(fit)["event_date:conv_cluster4",])
}
```

```{r sup-table-results-longitudinal-dfso}
supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO <- smooth_spline_model_loop %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Module (or Feature)") %>%
  dplyr::select(`Module (or Feature)`, p.slope, p.intercept, adjp.slope, adjp.intercept, conv_cluster4, `event_date:conv_cluster4`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(coef.intercept = conv_cluster4, 
         coef.slope = `event_date:conv_cluster4`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -`Module (or Feature)`, names_to = c("cname", "Analysis"), names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cname, values_from = value) %>%
  #filter(p <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Analysis = recode(Analysis,
                           `slope` = "Longitudinal analysis DFSO - overall shape",
                           `intercept` = "Longitudinal analysis DFSO- overall average"),
         Direction = ifelse(test = sign(coef) %in% 1,
                            yes  = "Severe",
                            no   = "Mild")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(`P value` = p,
           `Q value` = adjp) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Module (or Feature)`,
         Analysis,
         `P value`,`Q value`,
         Direction) %>%
  `rownames<-`(NULL)
               
supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO %>%
  head() %>%
  kable()
```

```{r add-longidinal-pairwise-dfso}
# use linear regression to infer direction
inputDF$conv_cluster4 = unfactor(inputDF$conv_cluster4)
combMat <- combn(unique(inputDF$conv_cluster4), m = 2)
coefCombMat <- apply(combMat, MARGIN = 2, FUN = function(comparison) {
  inputTemp <- filter(inputDF, conv_cluster4 %in% comparison)
  
  coefDF <- lapply(rownames(smooth_spline_model_loop), FUN = function(modName) {
    fit <- lme(fixed  = value ~ event_date * conv_cluster4 + sex + discretized_admit_age_quantile,
               random = ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id,
               data   = filter(inputTemp, name %in% modName))
    average <- unique(coef(fit)[grep(pattern = "^conv_cluster4",
                                     colnames(coef(fit)))]) %>%
      unlist() %>%
      unname()
    shape <- unique(coef(fit)[grep(pattern = "^event_date:conv_cluster4",
                                     colnames(coef(fit)))]) %>%
      unlist() %>%
      unname()
    return(value = data.frame(`Module (or Feature)` = modName,
                              average, 
                              shape,
                              comparison = paste(sort(comparison), collapse = "|"),
                              check.names = FALSE))
  }) %>%
    do.call(what = rbind)
  return(value = coefDF)
}) %>%
  do.call(what = rbind)
```


```{r sup-table-results-longitudinal-pairwise-dfso}
supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSOPairwise <- smooth_spline_model_loop %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Module (or Feature)") %>%
  dplyr::select(`Module (or Feature)`, 
         matches(match = "^p.slope_.v.$"),
         matches(match = "^p.intercept_.v.$"),
         matches(match = "^p.slope.adj_.v.$"),
         matches(match = "^p.intercept.adj_.v.$")) %>%
   setNames(nm = gsub(pattern = "p(.+).adj_",
                     replacement = "adjp\\1_",
                     names(.))) %>%
 pivot_longer(cols          = -`Module (or Feature)`, 
               names_to      = c("cname", "Analysis"), 
               names_pattern = "(.*)\\.(.*)") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cname, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Analysis = gsub(pattern     = "slope",
                         replacement = "shape",
                         Analysis),
         Analysis = gsub(pattern     = "intercept",
                         replacement = "average",
                         Analysis),
         Analysis = gsub(pattern = "^p\\.(.+)_(.)v(.)$",
                         replacement = "Longitudinal analysis DFSO - \\2|\\3 \\1",
                         Analysis))%>%
  dplyr::rename(`P value` = p,
         `Q value` = adjp)
coefCombMat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = -c(`Module (or Feature)`, comparison),
               names_to  = "Analysis",
               values_to = "Direction") %>%
  mutate(Analysis = paste("Longitudinal analysis DFSO -",
                          comparison,
                          Analysis),
         Direction = ifelse(test = sign(Direction) %in% 1,
                            yes  = "Severe",
                            no   = "Mild")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-comparison) %>%
  merge(x  = supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSOPairwise,
        by = c("Module (or Feature)", "Analysis")) -> supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSOPairwise

# append to overall results
supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSOPairwise %>%
  #filter(`P value` <= 0.05) %>%
  rbind(supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO, .) -> supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO
                                    
supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO <- supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO  %>%
  mutate(`Module (or Feature)` = paste0(ASSAY, ".", `Module (or Feature)`))
supTab_resultsLongitudinalDFSO %>%
  tail() %>%
  kable()
```

```{r}
data_use <- wgcnaRes$MEs %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample_id") %>%
  merge(y  = dplyr::select(clinical_data, 
                    sample_id, 
                    event_date,
                    conv_cluster4,
                    enrollment_site,
                    discretized_admit_age_quantile,
                    sex,
                    bmi,
                    participant_id,event_location),
        by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(conv_cluster4)) %>%
  filter(duplicated(participant_id) | duplicated(participant_id, fromLast = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = factor(conv_cluster4)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("sample_id", "event_date", "participant_id",
                         "enrollment_site", "conv_cluster4",
                         "discretized_admit_age_quantile", "sex", "bmi", "event_location")) %>%
  mutate(discretized_admit_age_quantile= factor(discretized_admit_age_quantile)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))
```

```{r panel-c-output-gen, fig.height=4, fig.width=15}
exampleDF <- data_use %>%
  filter(name %in% "globalmet_mod0") %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = ordered(as.factor(as.character(conv_cluster4)), 
                                    levels = c("1", "2", "5", "6")))

plotExample <- plot_model(exampleDF, 
                          model_loop     = smooth_spline_model_loop, 
                          modelType      = "smoothSpline", 
                          p_adjust       = NA, 
                          endpoint       = "conv_cluster4", 
                          signif_markers = FALSE,
                          remove_NS      = TRUE, 
                          bar_height     = 6.5)

plotMod0 <- plotExample$data %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = paste0("CC", conv_cluster4)) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = event_date, y = value)) +
  #ggtitle("mod6 - Branched Chain Amino Acids") +
    geom_line(mapping = aes(group = participant_id, y = value), 
              color   = 'gray',
              alpha   = 0.4) +
    geom_line(mapping = aes(group = participant_id, y = yhat), 
              size    = 0.6, 
              alpha   = 0.5,
              color   = "black") +
    geom_point(mapping = aes(color = conv_cluster4)) +
    geom_line(data    = mutate(get("pred", plotExample$plot_env),
                               conv_cluster4 = paste0("CC", 
                                                         conv_cluster4)),
              mapping = aes(group = conv_cluster4, y = predicted),
                           color = "black", size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(facets = ~conv_cluster4, nrow = 1) +
    labs(y = "Eigenvalue",  x = "Days from admission") + #,  tag = "C"

                                 "CC2"  = "#39828C",
                                 "CC5"  = "#9C3418",
                                 "CC6"  = "#0072B2")) +
```

### Pooled analysis code
```{r pooled analysis code, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, message=FALSE}

data_use_pooled_4TG <- data_use %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = recode(conv_cluster6, `1` = 1, `3` = 1, `4` = 1, `2` = 2, `5` = 5, `6` = 6)) %>%
  select(sample_id, N1_CT, N2_CT, 
         enrollment_site,
         conv_cluster4,
         participant_id,
         event_type,
         event_date,
         discretized_admit_age_quantile,
         sex = sex) %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  mutate(conv_cluster4 = factor(conv_cluster4, levels = c("1", "2", "5", "6"))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "sample_id")

immune_assay <- data_use_pooled_4TG %>%
  select(N1_CT, N2_CT)
immune_meta <- data_use_pooled_4TG %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "sample_id") %>%
  select(sample_id, 
         participant_id,
         event_type,
         event_date,
         discretized_admit_age_quantile,
         sex,
         enrollment_site,
         conv_cluster4)


if(!(all(rownames(immune_assay) == immune_meta$sample_id))){
  stop("make sure samples are ordered consistent between counts data and metadata")
} else {message("samples are ordered consistent between counts data and metadata")}


response_name = "conv_cluster4"
random_effect_list = c("participant_id", "enrollment_site")
fixed_effect_list = c("sex", "discretized_admit_age_quantile")
# fixed_effect_list = c("event_type","sex", "discretized_admit_age_quantile")

# over all association

module_names <- c("N1_CT", "N2_CT")

pval_overall <- NULL

for (moduleName in module_names) {
  my.formula0 <- paste0(moduleName, '~(1|enrollment_site)+(1|participant_id)+discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex')
  my.formula1 <- paste0(moduleName,
                        '~(1|enrollment_site)+(1|participant_id)+discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex+conv_cluster4')
  av = anova(lme4::lmer(my.formula0, data = data_use_pooled_4TG),
                 lme4::lmer(my.formula1, data = data_use_pooled_4TG))
  res <- av$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  pval_overall <- rbind(pval_overall, res)
}

res_table_overall <- data.frame(feature = module_names, 
                                pval = as.vector(pval_overall)) %>% 
  mutate(qval =  qvalue::qvalue(pval, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "feature")


# pairwise comparisons
pooled_resDF_pairwise <- NULL
for(feature_name in colnames(immune_assay)){
  res0 = pooled_test(immune_assay=immune_assay, immune_meta=immune_meta, 
                     feature_name = feature_name, response_name=response_name, 
                     random_effect_list=random_effect_list , fix_effect_list=fixed_effect_list)
  pooled_resDF_pairwise <- rbind(pooled_resDF_pairwise,res0)
}
rownames(pooled_resDF_pairwise) = colnames(immune_assay)

res_table_pooled_all <- cbind(res_table_overall, pooled_resDF_pairwise)


```

```{r}
data_use_mod25 <- subset(data_use, name=="globalmet_mod25")

  group_by(conv_cluster4) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mod25_mean = mean(data_use$value))

boxplot_mod25 <- ggplot(data_use_mod25, aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = value)) + 
  geom_quasirandom(aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = value, color = conv_cluster4), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = value, fill = conv_cluster4), size = 1, alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(data = df_pooled_mean, aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = mod25_mean), color = "black", size = 5, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Eigenvalue") + xlab("Convalescent clusters") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
```

#Metabolomics Repeated Measures Analysis (Pooled Analysis)
```{r load-codebase, results="hide", fig.show="hide", message=FALSE}
# load codebase.R, metabolomics data and clinical information
# source("~/bitbucket/impacc/Analysis/data_analysis_template_codebase.R")
source("/scratch/metabolomics/plasma-metabolomics-global/scripts/conv/data_analysis_template_codebase_conv.R") 
source("/scratch/metabolomics/plasma-metabolomics-global/scripts/conv/codebase_conv_immune.R")
source("/scratch/metabolomics/plasma-metabolomics-global/scripts/conv/codebase.R")

data_env <- load_IMPACC_datasets(DATA_VERSION               = "2023-01-18",
                                KEEP_COVID19_POS            = FALSE,
                                FILTER_BY_CORE_ASSAY_COHORT = FALSE)

for (n in grep(pattern = "metabolomics|clinical_data", 
               names(data_env), 
               value   = TRUE)) {
  assign(n, value = data_env[[n]])
}

#### Here, read the convalescent file
conv_file <- read_csv("/scratch/clinical/current/impacc-convalescent.csv") %>% mutate_if(is.character, str_trim)
names(conv_file)[3] <- "conv_cluster4"
clinical_all <- merge(clinical_data, conv_file, by = "participant_id", all.x = TRUE)
clinical_data <- clinical_all


# combine conv clusters 1, 3, and 4 -> 1 = 1,3,4
clinical_data$conv_cluster4 <- ifelse(clinical_data$conv_cluster4 == 2, 2, 
                                     ifelse(clinical_data$conv_cluster4 == 5, 5,
                                            ifelse(clinical_data$conv_cluster4 == 6, 6, 1)))
clinical_data$conv_cluster4 <- as.numeric(clinical_data$conv_cluster4)

```

#Prepare data
```{r data preparation}
#immune data example
sample_type= "PROTEOMICS/MET"
#immune_assay = plasma_metabolomics_global_counts
data_use_wide <- pivot_wider(data_use)
immune_assay = data_use_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1, 10:36)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var="sample_id")

#tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "sample_id") %>%
#rownames(immune_assay) <- immune_assay[1]
#immune_assay$sample_id <- NULL

sample_ids = data.frame(sample_id =  rownames(immune_assay))
clinical_data_sub = clinical_data[clinical_data$sample_type==sample_type&clinical_data$sample_id %in%sample_ids$sample_id,]
immune_meta = sample_ids %>%
          left_join(clinical_data_sub, by = "sample_id")
sample_idx_keep = which(!is.na(immune_meta$conv_cluster4))
immune_meta=immune_meta[sample_idx_keep,]
immune_assay=immune_assay[sample_idx_keep,]
```

#Pooled analysis - pairwise comparisons
```{r pooled analysis}
response_name = "conv_cluster4"
random_effect_list = c("participant_id", "enrollment_site")
fixed_effect_list = c("event_type","sex", "discretized_admit_age_quantile", "event_location") 
pooled_resDF_pairwise <- NULL
for(feature_name in colnames(immune_assay)){
  res0 = pooled_test(immune_assay=immune_assay, immune_meta=immune_meta, 
                     feature_name = feature_name, response_name=response_name, 
                     random_effect_list=random_effect_list , fix_effect_list=fixed_effect_list)
  pooled_resDF_pairwise <- rbind(pooled_resDF_pairwise,res0)
}
rownames(pooled_resDF_pairwise) = colnames(immune_assay)
print(pooled_resDF_pairwise)
```


```{r}
#overall pvalue - module-level repeated measures

#module_names <- c("N1_CT", "N2_CT")
module_names <- colnames(immune_assay)

pval_overall <- NULL

for (moduleName in module_names) {
  my.formula0 <- paste0(moduleName, '~(1|enrollment_site)+(1|participant_id)+discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex')
  my.formula1 <- paste0(moduleName,
                        '~(1|enrollment_site)+(1|participant_id)+discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex+conv_cluster4')
  av = anova(lme4::lmer(my.formula0, data = data_use_wide),
                 lme4::lmer(my.formula1, data = data_use_wide))
  res <- av$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  pval_overall <- rbind(pval_overall, res)
}

res_table_overall <- data.frame(feature = module_names, 
                                pval = as.vector(pval_overall)) %>% 
  mutate(qval =  qvalue::qvalue(pval, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "feature")
```

#PRO clustering
```{r trajectory analysis}
response_name = "conv_cluster4"
time_name = "event_date"
random_effect_list = c("participant_id", "enrollment_site")
fixed_effect_list = c("sex", "discretized_admit_age_quantile")
```

```{r}
model_loop_mini <- function(inputDF, modelType = "lme", age_sex =TRUE, knots = c(1, 4, 7, 14, 21),
                       endpoint = "trajectory_group", old_p_corrections = FALSE){
  inputDF$participant_id = as.factor(inputDF$participant_id )
  if(modelType == "smoothSpline"){
    inputDF$event_date_transformed = inputDF$event_date
    lmDF <- mgcv_global(inputDF, endpoint, age_sex = age_sex)
    lmDF$name <- rownames(lmDF)
    ## Because of the pairwise function requires there to be a column for "name"
    ## the rownames are copied to a new column here, ultimately this column is removed
  } else {
    lmDF <- inputDF %>%
      group_by(name) %>% 
      do(p.slope = {
        if(modelType == "lme"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                            "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
            
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint)), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
        } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                             "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint)), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
        }
        if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
            idx <- nrow(anova(fit))
            result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[idx]
        } else {
          result = NA
        }
      }, 
      p.intercept = {
        if(modelType == "lme"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint)), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
        } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
          if(age_sex){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else{
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint)), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
          
        }
        if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
          result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[3] #trajectory_group is position 3
        }else{
          result = NA
        }
      },
      p.intercept.sex = {
        if(age_sex){
          if(modelType == "lme"){
              fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                                                       "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), data = .,
                             random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
              fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                                                       "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), 
                             data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
          if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
            result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[4] ## sex is position 4
          } else {
            result = NA
          }
        }
      },
      p.intercept.age.quantile = {
        if(age_sex){
          if(modelType == "lme"){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ event_date * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), data = .,
                           random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          } else if (modelType == "fixedKnots"){
            fit <- try(lme(fixed = as.formula(paste0("value ~ splines::bs(event_date, 
                             knots =c(",paste(knots, collapse = ',') ,")) * ", endpoint,
                                                     "+sex+discretized_admit_age_quantile")), 
                           data = .,random =  ~1|enrollment_site/participant_id))
          }
          if(class(fit)[1]!="try-error"){
            result = (anova(fit)$"p-value")[5] ## discretized_admit_age_quantile is position 4
          } else {
            result = NA
          }
        }
      }
      ) %>% ungroup() %>%
      mutate(p.slope = unlist(p.slope),
             p.intercept  = unlist(p.intercept),
             p.intercept.sex  = unlist(p.intercept.sex),
             p.intercept.age.quantile  = unlist(p.intercept.age.quantile),
      ) %>% as.data.frame()
    lmDF$adjp.intercept=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.intercept, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
    lmDF$adjp.slope=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.slope, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
   # lmDF$adjp.intercept.sex=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.intercept.sex, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
   # lmDF$adjp.intercept.age.quantile=qvalue::qvalue(lmDF$p.intercept.age.quantile, fdr.level = 0.05, pi0 = 1)$qvalues
  }
  
  
  
  return(lmDF)
}
```

```{r}
TrajGrpCol <- c("1" = "#639A21", "2" = "#39828C", "5" = "#9C3418", "6" = "#0072B2")

library(ggbeeswarm)

res_table_pairwise_long_df <- pooled_resDF_pairwise %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "feature") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("feature")) %>%
  rename(Pvalue = value) %>%
  tidyr::separate(col = "name", into = c("group1", "group2"), remove = FALSE)

res_table_pairwise_long_df_temp <- res_table_pairwise_long_df %>%
  filter(feature == "X55") %>%
  filter(Pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(Pvalue = round(Pvalue,4)) %>%
  dplyr::select(group1, group2, Pvalue) %>%
  mutate(`y.position` = c(41)) %>%
  as.tibble()
  
  
library(ggprism)


## X100001400 figure
my_comparisons <- list(c(1,6), c(2,6), c(5,6), c(1,2), c(1,5))
alpha = 0.05

inputDF_X100001400 <- subset(inputDF, name=="X100001400")
inputDF_X100001400$conv_cluster4 <- as.factor(inputDF_X100001400$conv_cluster4)

df_pooled_mean <- inputDF_X100001400 %>%
  group_by(conv_cluster4) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            X100001400_mean = mean(inputDF$value))

boxplot_X100001400 <- ggplot(inputDF_X100001400, aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = value)) + 
  geom_quasirandom(aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = value, color = conv_cluster4), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = value, fill = conv_cluster4), size = 1, alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(data = df_pooled_mean, aes(x = conv_cluster4, y = X100001400_mean), color = "black", size = 5, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Metabolite") + xlab("Convalescent clusters") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        text = element_text(size=16)) +
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = TrajGrpCol) +
  scale_color_manual(values = TrajGrpCol) +
  #add_pvalue(res_table_pairwise_long_df_temp, 
   #          label = "Pvalue",
    #         vjust = 3.5) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(45, 8))
ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif")

print(boxplot_X100001400)
```

### Convalescent Symptoms Analysis

```{r}
#Import convalescent symptom data
sympdata <- read.csv("/scratch/clinical/current/impacc_conv_symptoms.csv")

#Merge clinical data with convalescent symptom data
data.lr <- merge(clinical_data, sympdata, by = "participant_id")

#Select desired variables to keep in dataset
data.lr <- data.lr[c('participant_id', 'sample_id', 'event_location', 'sex', 'discretized_admit_age_quantile', 'conv_cluster4', 'convsx_cardio_1plus', 'convsx_systemic_1plus', 'convsx_other_1plus', 'convsx_1plus_count', 'convsx_cardio_2plus', 'convsx_systemic_2plus', 'convsx_other_2plus', 'convsx_2plus_count')]

#Merge dataset with assay data (i.e. metabolomics = inputDF from repeated measures analysis) to include assay variable 
datfinal <- merge(data.lr, inputDF, by = "participant_id", all.x = TRUE)

#Select desired variables to keep in final dataset
#datfinal <- datfinal[c('participant_id', 'sample_id', 'event_location', 'sex.x', 'discretized_admit_age_quantile.x', 'conv_cluster4.x', #'convsx_cardio_1plus', 'convsx_systemic_1plus', 'convsx_other_1plus', 'convsx_1plus_count', 'convsx_cardio_2plus', 'convsx_systemic_2plus', #'convsx_other_2plus', 'convsx_2plus_count', 'met_ID')]

#Remove duplicates of participant_id from merge (only for logistic regression)
datfinal <- datfinal[!duplicated(datfinal$participant_id), ]

#Remove any missing values
datfinal <- na.omit(datfinal)

names(datfinal)[names(datfinal) == 'sex.x'] <- 'sex'
names(datfinal)[names(datfinal) == 'discretized_admit_age_quantile.x'] <- 'discretized_admit_age_quantile'
names(datfinal)[names(datfinal) == 'conv_cluster4.x'] <- 'conv_cluster4'
#names(datfinal)[names(datfinal) == 'met_ID'] <- 'MET_ID'
```

```{r}
#write.csv(smooth_spline_model_loop_4TG,"phase4b_subset_adjslope.csv",row.names=F)

#Import significant metabolite dataset 
subset_adjslope <- read.csv("phase4b_subset_adjslope.csv", header = TRUE)
names(subset_adjslope)[names(subset_adjslope) == 'MET_ID'] <- 'name'

#Merge datfinal with significant metabolites dataset
datfinal_sig <- merge(datfinal, subset_adjslope, by = "name")

#Remove duplicates of sample_id
datfinal_sig <- datfinal_sig[!duplicated(datfinal_sig$sample_id), ]

#Select relevant columns
datfinal_sig <- datfinal_sig %>% select(1:21)

```

#glmer
```{r}
#find fitted variable that is causing error/complete separation (leads to unrealistic parameter estimates)
fixed <- paste0("convsx_cardio_1plus~name+discretized_admit_age_quantile+sex+event_location")
fixed_model <- glm(fixed, data=datfinal_sig, family = binomial)
#removing age variable from formula does not lead to seperation error (glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred)
#therefore, age variable is causing complete separation - approach: include as random effect to shrink overall mean
```

```{r}
# convsx_cardio_1plus
my.formula1 <- paste0("convsx_cardio_1plus~name+sex+event_location+(1|discretized_admit_age_quantile)+(1|enrollment_site)+(1|participant_id)")
convsx_cardio_1plus_fit <- glmer(my.formula1, data = datfinal_sig, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optCtrl=list(maxfun=1e6)), nAGQ=1)
summary(convsx_cardio_1plus_fit)
```

```{r}
###Sytemic_2plus figures - 3 significant metabolites from logistic regression

#Subset for significant metabolite
datfinal_X100000445 <- subset(datfinal, name %in% c("X100000445"))
names(datfinal_X100000445)[names(datfinal_X100000445) == 'value'] <- 'met_value'
names(datfinal_X100000445)[names(datfinal_X100000445) == 'name'] <- 'met_id'


data_plot_long_df <- datfinal_X100000445 %>%
  select(participant_id, event_location, met_id, met_value, convsx_cardio_1plus, convsx_systemic_1plus, convsx_other_1plus, convsx_cardio_2plus, convsx_systemic_2plus, convsx_other_2plus, convsx_1plus_count, convsx_2plus_count) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("event_location", "participant_id", "met_id", "met_value"),  names_repair = "minimal")

my_comparisons <- list(c(1,6), c(1,2), c(1,5), c(2,5), c(2,6), c(5,6))
alpha = 0.05

boxplot_conv_symp_systemic_2plus_X100000445 <- data_plot_long_df %>%
  filter(name %in% c("convsx_systemic_2plus")) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("convsx_systemic_2plus"))) %>%
  drop_na(value) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = met_value, fill = value)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = value, y = met_value, fill = value), size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~name, ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("met_value") + xlab("Convalescent symptom groups") +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4))
  #scale_fill_manual(values = color_remdes) +
 # scale_y_reverse()
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, label = "p.signif")
  
print(boxplot_conv_symp_systemic_2plus_X100000445)
```

# Code from Jing Chen for metabolomic enrichment analysis

```{r}
library(RaMP)
library(DT) # for prettier tables in vignette
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library("MetaboAnalystR")
library(stringr)
```

#functions
```{r}

#Collect significant ids
sig_ids <- function(cmpd.vec, type){


  cmpd.vec <- cmpd.vec

  for (p in cmpd.vec) {
    if (grepl(",", p)){
      temp <- str_split(p, ",")[[1]]
      cmpd.vec <- c(cmpd.vec, temp)
      cmpd.vec <- cmpd.vec[cmpd.vec!= p]
    }

  }
  cmpd.vec <- cmpd.vec[!is.na(cmpd.vec)]
  if(type == "ramp"){
    cmpd.vec_new <- c()
    for (p in cmpd.vec) {
      nes_hm <- paste("hmdb", p , sep = ":")
      cmpd.vec_new <- c(cmpd.vec_new, nes_hm)
    }


    return(unique(cmpd.vec_new))
  }
  else{
    return(unique(cmpd.vec))
  }
}
#Run RaMP...
run_ramp <- function(ids){

  fisher.results <- runCombinedFisherTest(analytes = c(ids))

  filtered.fisher.results <- FilterFishersResults(fisher.results, pval_type = 'fdr', pval_cutoff=0.05)
  if (dim(filtered.fisher.results$fishresults)[1] > 0){
    clusters <- RaMP::findCluster(filtered.fisher.results,
                                  perc_analyte_overlap = 0.2,
                                  min_pathway_tocluster = 2, perc_pathway_overlap = 0.2)
    #datatable(clusters$fishresults %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, ~ round(., 8)),
    #                    rownames = FALSE)
    pathwayResultsPlot_2 <- pathwayResultsPlot(filtered.fisher.results, text_size = 8, perc_analyte_overlap = 0.2,
                                               min_pathway_tocluster = 2, perc_pathway_overlap = 0.2, interactive = FALSE)
    return(pathwayResultsPlot_2)
  }
  else{
    return("No results found")
  }

}

# Generate bubble plot
bubble_plot <- function(significant_table, metabolomics_rf){

  Sub_size <- c()
  Sub_pathway <- c()
  if(is.factor(metabolomics_rf$SUB_PATHWAY)){
    metabolomics_rf$SUB_PATHWAY <- unfactor(metabolomics_rf$SUB_PATHWAY)
  }
  subpath_list <- unique(metabolomics_rf$SUB_PATHWAY)

  for(i in subpath_list){
    if (!is.na(i)){
      sub_table <- metabolomics_rf %>% filter(SUB_PATHWAY == i)

    sub <- unique(sub_table$SUB_PATHWAY)
    Sub_pathway <- c(Sub_pathway, sub)

    size_sub <- length(sub_table$SUB_PATHWAY)
    Sub_size <- c(Sub_size, size_sub)
    }
    


  }
  Sub_pathway_table <- data.table(Sub_pathway, Sub_size)
  results_sig <- significant_table
  results_sig_more <- merge(results_sig, Sub_pathway_table, by= "SUB_PATHWAY", by.y = "Sub_pathway")
  results_sig_more$SUPER_PATHWAY <- as.character(results_sig_more$SUPER_PATHWAY)
  pathwayfile <- results_sig_more
  pathwayfile$pvals[pathwayfile$pvals == 0] <- 0.00000000000000000001
  pathwayfile$`-log10p` <- -log10(pathwayfile$pvals)
  subpath_list <- unique(pathwayfile$SUB_PATHWAY)

  Super_pathway <- c()
  Sub_pathway <- c()
  mean_p <- c()
  #Size <- c()
  Impact_ratio <- c()
  Increase_ratio <- c()
  ###### impact ratio: # of significant / # of total in the subpathway 0-1
  for(i in subpath_list){
    sub_table <- pathwayfile %>% filter(SUB_PATHWAY == i)

    supp <- unique(sub_table$SUPER_PATHWAY)
    Super_pathway <- c(Super_pathway, supp)

    sub <- unique(sub_table$SUB_PATHWAY)
    Sub_pathway <- c(Sub_pathway, sub)

    mean_qval <- mean(sub_table$`-log10p`)
    mean_p <- c(mean_p, mean_qval)

    size_sub <- length(sub_table$SUB_PATHWAY)
    #Size <- c(Size, size_sub)
    size_all <- unique(sub_table$Sub_size)
    im_ratio <- size_sub/size_all
    Impact_ratio <- c(Impact_ratio, im_ratio)

    #increased_table <- sub_table 
    #increased_num <- length(increased_table$CHEMICAL_NAME) / size_sub
    #Increase_ratio <- c(Increase_ratio, increased_num)

  }
  path_output <- data.table(Super_pathway, Sub_pathway, mean_p, Impact_ratio)#Size , Increase_ratio
  #path_output <- path_output[order(Super_pathway, desc(mean_p)),]
  path_output <- path_output[order(Super_pathway),]

  path_output$Super_pathway2 <- path_output$Super_pathway
  path_output$Super_pathway2 <- factor(path_output$Super_pathway, levels = c("Peptide", "Partially Characterized Molecules", "Nucleotide", "Lipid", "Energy", "Cofactors and Vitamins", "Carbohydrate", "Amino Acid"))
  p <- path_output %>%
    arrange(Super_pathway,mean_p) %>% mutate(Sub_pathway=factor(Sub_pathway, levels=Sub_pathway)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Sub_pathway , y =mean_p)) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c()+
    geom_tile(aes(fill = Super_pathway2), height = Inf, alpha = 0.3) +
    #geom_point(aes(size = Impact_ratio, colour = Increase_ratio)) + #Size
    geom_point(aes(size = Impact_ratio),shape = 1,colour = "black") +  #Size
    theme_light() +
    coord_flip()
  return(p)
}
#run MetaboAnalyst
Run_MetaboAnalyst <- function(ids, method){

  results_annotation_results <- data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = 4))
  colnames(results_annotation_results) <- c("Short Name", "Annotation resource", "Raw p", "FDR")
  mSet<-InitDataObjects("conc", "msetora", FALSE)
  cmpd.vec <- ids
  mSet<-Setup.MapData(mSet, cmpd.vec)
  mSet<-CrossReferencing(mSet, "hmdb")
  mSet<-CreateMappingResultTable(mSet)
  mSet<-SetMetabolomeFilter(mSet, F)
  if(method == "smpdb_v2"){
    #mSet<-SetCurrentMsetLib(mSet, "smpdb_pathway", 2)
    mSet<-Setup.UserMsetLibData(mSet, "/data/resources/databases/SMPDB/current/SMPDB_results.csv")
    mSet<-SetCurrentMsetLib(mSet, "self", 2)
  }
  else if(method == "smpdb_v1"){
    mSet<-SetCurrentMsetLib(mSet, "smpdb_pathway", 2)
  }
  else if (method == "kegg"){
    mSet<-SetCurrentMsetLib(mSet, "kegg_pathway", 2)
  }

  skip_to_next <- FALSE


  tryCatch(mSet<-CalculateHyperScore(mSet), error = function(e) { skip_to_next <<- TRUE})

  if(skip_to_next) {

    next
  }


  if (length(mSet)==9){
    mSet<-SaveTransformedData(mSet)
    results_annotation <- as.data.frame(mSet$analSet$ora.mat)
    results_annotation$`Short Name` <- rownames(results_annotation)
    results_annotation <- results_annotation[,c(7,4,6)]

    results_annotation$`Annotation resource` <- method
    results_annotation <- results_annotation[,c(1,4,2,3)]
    results_annotation_results <- rbind(results_annotation_results, results_annotation)
    #mSet<-PlotORA(mSet, "ora_0_", "net", "png", 72, width=NA)


    a <- PlotEnrichDotPlot_md(mSet, enrichType = "ora")


  }
  results_annotation_results <- results_annotation_results[-1,]

  return(list(table =results_annotation_results, figure = a))
}

PlotEnrichDotPlot_md <- function(mSet, enrichType = "ora", width=NA){

  mSetObj <- mSet;



  if(enrichType == "ora"){
    results <- as.data.frame(mSetObj$analSet$ora.mat)
    #results <- results[results$`Raw p` <= 0.05,]
    #results <- filter(results, `Raw p` <= 0.05)
    my.cols <- GetMyHeatCols(nrow(results));
    #if(nrow(results) > 50){

     # results <- results[1:50,]
    #  my.cols <- my.cols[1:50];
   #}

    df <- data.frame(Name = factor(row.names(results), levels = rev(row.names(results))),
                     rawp = results[,4],
                     logp = -log10(results[,4]),
                     folds = results[,3]/results[,2])
    df$rawp <- as.numeric(df$rawp)
    df <- df[df$rawp<= 0.05,]
    if(nrow(df) > 50){

      df <- df[1:50,]
        my.cols <- my.cols[1:50]
      }

  }else if(enrichType == "qea"){
    results <- mSetObj$analSet$qea.mat
    my.cols <- GetMyHeatCols(nrow(results));
    if(nrow(results) > 25){
      results <- results[1:25,]
      my.cols <- my.cols[1:25];
    }
    df <- data.frame(Name = factor(row.names(results), levels = rev(row.names(results))),
                     rawp = results[,5],
                     logp = -log10(results[,5]),
                     folds = results[,3]/results[,4]
    )

  }

  maxp <- max(df$rawp);
  #imgName = paste(imgName, "dpi", dpi, ".", format, sep="");

  if(is.na(width)){
    w <- 12;
    h <- 9;
  }else if(width == 0){
    h <- w <- 7;
  }else{
    h <- w <- width;
  }
  if (nrow(df) >0){
    p <- ggplot(df,
                aes(x = logp, y = Name)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = folds, color = rawp)) + scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14.5) +
      scale_colour_gradient(limits=c(0, maxp), low=my.cols[1], high = my.cols[length(my.cols)]) +
      ylab(NULL) + xlab("-log10 (p-value)") +
      ggtitle("Overview of Enriched Metabolite Sets (Top 50)") +
      theme(legend.text=element_text(size=14),
            legend.title=element_text(size=15))

    p$labels$colour <- "P-value"
    p$labels$size <- "Enrichment Ratio"

    #ggsave(p, filename = imgName, dpi=dpi, width=w, height=h)

    #if(enrichType == "ora"){
    #  mSetObj$imgSet$ora <- imgName
    #}else if(enrichType == "qea"){
    #  mSetObj$imgSet$qea <-imgName;
    # }

    #mSetObj$imgSet$current.img <- imgName;
    return(p);
  }
else{
  return("No significant")
}

}

GetMyHeatCols <- function(len){
  if(len > 50){
    ht.col <- c(substr(heat.colors(50), 0, 7), rep("#FFFFFF", len-50));
  }else{
    # reduce to hex by remove the last character so HTML understand
    ht.col <- substr(heat.colors(len), 0, 7);
  }
}
```
